name: Riand
description: Urza's student sent to steal Maraavis's egg and cursed by her.

description_citations.text: "The Dragons of Magic". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza's student Riand steals Maraavis's egg for the Metathran; Maraavis confronts Urza, strikes a bargain and traps Riand in an illusion.
timeline.quote: Maraavis then enchants Riand to experience an illusion of falling to his death on jagged reefs on-loop for 1000 days.

citation.text: "The Dragons of Magic", section "Of Protectors & Pride , by Steven E. Schend". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.quote: she will get to punish Riand as she sees fit
